name: Max Truman
source: The muscle of Squad Zero, Max is an elite assassin under the Zero Program, an assassin branch inside of the secret agent organization Adelcorp. Max is one of the older members of Squad Zero, along with Amelia and Rosaline. Max considers himself a born leader, and rightfully so, as he tries his best to hold the morale and foundation of the squad on his back when the head of the Squad, Rosaline, is absent.
